item.title: [−1] India–US trade talks have 'reached a plateau', finance minister says; compromise 'very difficult'
item.description:
Sitharaman said further give-and-take would be very difficult, after a US law allowed tariffs of up to 100% on big buyers of Russian oil. Talks continue. Escalating from last week's reports of delays.

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — Farm and seafood exports exposed

Why it matters: A stalled deal keeps US tariff risk hanging over Indian exporters and weighs on foreign investor sentiment and the rupee.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] India's LNG imports fall 14% in September; Oman becomes top supplier with a 27% share
item.description:
India imported 585,000 tonnes of LNG from Oman in September, overtaking the US, now third at 16%. Qatar's share fell after earlier damage at its main export hub. Ongoing supply diversification.

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — Fertiliser plants need gas

Why it matters: Lower LNG volumes tighten gas for city-gas distributors, fertiliser plants and industry, while diversification reduces dependence on the Hormuz route.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Ship sinks in Black Sea after drone attack, three Indian crew safe; India seeks shipping-safety deal
item.description:
A Turkish-owned cargo ship sank off Romania, killing two; three Indian crew survived. India's foreign minister said New Delhi is talking to Russia and Ukraine on Black Sea shipping safety, grain and energy exports. Escalating.

Agri & fertilisers: mild headwind (−1) — Fertiliser and edible oil supply risk

Why it matters: Black Sea attacks threaten supplies of sunflower oil, grain and fertiliser that India imports; a deal brokered with India's help would ease that risk.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
